scope: Authored Traditional Chinese / English engineering learning units; public principles, not proprietary recipes.

courses.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入凸塊共面性、電流密度與界面可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore bump coplanarity, current density and interface reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 互連幾何與來料
stages.description: 針對互連幾何與來料完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interconnect geometry and input, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Pad and bump coordinates | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對焊墊與凸塊座標，把「焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For pad and bump coordinates, turn "Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「焊墊與凸塊座標」的模型：焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for pad and bump coordinates: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付焊墊與凸塊座標的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for pad and bump coordinates, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標：機制
knowledge.text: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。
knowledge.textEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 必須排除的錯判：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「焊墊與凸塊座標」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？

options: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。
以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊
初始電阻低就代表疲勞壽命長
optionsEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.
Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap
Assuming low initial resistance proves long fatigue life
quiz.explanation: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 因此不能採用「以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊」。
quiz.explanationEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Therefore reject: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap.

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Challenge the hypothesis "Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付焊墊與凸塊座標的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for pad and bump coordinates: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.objectiveEn: For seed continuity, turn "A discontinuous seed disrupts local potential and deposition; identical nominal thickness does not guarantee continuity over topography." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「種子層連續性」的模型：開路種子層使局部電位與沉積量失控；名義厚度相同不保證跨地形導通。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「以片電阻地圖配合截面查看孔邊覆蓋，將探針接觸異常另列。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for seed continuity: A discontinuous seed disrupts local potential and deposition; identical nominal thickness does not guarantee continuity over topography. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Combine sheet-resistance maps with cross-sections at aperture edges and isolate probe-contact errors. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.failure: 避免：僅用中心種子厚度證明全片電鍍連通。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.objective: 針對電荷與高度預算，把「法拉第關係把總電荷連到理想沉積質量，實際高度還受電流效率、有效面積及邊緣電流影響。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For charge and height budget, turn "Faraday's relation links charge to ideal deposited mass; actual height also depends on current efficiency, active area and edge current." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「電荷與高度預算」的模型：法拉第關係把總電荷連到理想沉積質量，實際高度還受電流效率、有效面積及邊緣電流影響。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「固定圖形密度比較電荷與高度斜率，檢查中心至邊緣殘差。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for charge and height budget: Faraday's relation links charge to ideal deposited mass; actual height also depends on current efficiency, active area and edge current. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 固定圖形密度比較電荷與高度斜率，檢查中心至邊緣殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總電荷相同必有相同每顆柱高。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal total charge gives equal height at every pillar. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付電荷與高度預算的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.objectiveEn: For pattern density and coplanarity, turn "Dense and sparse patterns redistribute local current; define coplanarity at both die-contact and wafer-distribution scales." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：繪製柱高直方圖並依圖形密度分組，報告最大最小差與重複量測。 將「平均柱高相同就能同時接觸」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Plot pillar-height histograms grouped by pattern density, reporting range and repeat measurements. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming equal mean pillar height ensures simultaneous contact" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 繪製柱高直方圖並依圖形密度分組，報告最大最小差與重複量測。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Plot pillar-height histograms grouped by pattern density, reporting range and repeat measurements. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均柱高相同就能同時接觸。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal mean pillar height ensures simultaneous contact. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付圖形密度與共面性的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for pattern density and coplanarity: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 圖形密度與共面性：機制
knowledge.text: 高低圖形密度區分配不同局部電流；共面性須以單晶粒接觸面與全片高度分布分別定義。
knowledge.textEn: Dense and sparse patterns redistribute local current; define coplanarity at both die-contact and wafer-distribution scales.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 繪製柱高直方圖並依圖形密度分組，報告最大最小差與重複量測。 必須排除的錯判：平均柱高相同就能同時接觸。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Plot pillar-height histograms grouped by pattern density, reporting range and repeat measurements. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming equal mean pillar height ensures simultaneous contact. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「圖形密度與共面性」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For pattern density and coplanarity — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 繪製柱高直方圖並依圖形密度分組，報告最大最小差與重複量測。
平均柱高相同就能同時接觸
最高剪切力必定代表最佳接合界面
optionsEn: Plot pillar-height histograms grouped by pattern density, reporting range and repeat measurements.
Assuming equal mean pillar height ensures simultaneous contact
Assuming the highest shear force identifies the best interface
quiz.explanation: 高低圖形密度區分配不同局部電流；共面性須以單晶粒接觸面與全片高度分布分別定義。 繪製柱高直方圖並依圖形密度分組，報告最大最小差與重複量測。 因此不能採用「平均柱高相同就能同時接觸」。
quiz.explanationEn: Dense and sparse patterns redistribute local current; define coplanarity at both die-contact and wafer-distribution scales. Plot pillar-height histograms grouped by pattern density, reporting range and repeat measurements. Therefore reject: Assuming equal mean pillar height ensures simultaneous contact.

steps.title: 銅微結構｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對銅微結構，把「晶粒與雜質影響延展、電阻與後續熱循環；室溫電阻正常並不排除脆化界面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For copper microstructure, turn "Grains and impurities affect ductility, resistance and thermal cycling; normal room-temperature resistance does not exclude embrittlement." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「銅微結構」的模型：晶粒與雜質影響延展、電阻與後續熱循環；室溫電阻正常並不排除脆化界面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將電阻、截面與熱處理前後微結構配對，保持樣本位置可追溯。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for copper microstructure: Grains and impurities affect ductility, resistance and thermal cycling; normal room-temperature resistance does not exclude embrittlement. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Pair resistance, cross-section and pre/post-thermal microstructure with traceable sampling positions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將電阻、截面與熱處理前後微結構配對，保持樣本位置可追溯。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Pair resistance, cross-section and pre/post-thermal microstructure with traceable sampling positions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：初始電阻低就代表疲勞壽命長。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming low initial resistance proves long fatigue life. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付銅微結構的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for copper microstructure, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 阻障與焊料帽｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Barrier and solder cap | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對阻障與焊料帽，把「阻障層與焊料帽在接合中參與擴散與反應；只報總凸塊高會掩蓋各層厚度不足。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For barrier and solder cap, turn "Barrier and solder cap participate in diffusion and reaction; reporting total bump height hides deficient individual layers." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「阻障與焊料帽」的模型：阻障層與焊料帽在接合中參與擴散與反應；只報總凸塊高會掩蓋各層厚度不足。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for barrier and solder cap: Barrier and solder cap participate in diffusion and reaction; reporting total bump height hides deficient individual layers. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付阻障與焊料帽的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for barrier and solder cap, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

options: 阻障層與焊料帽在接合中參與擴散與反應；只報總凸塊高會掩蓋各層厚度不足。

options: 各項各自合格就保證所有凸塊組裝成功
量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。
總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查
optionsEn: Assuming individual parameter passes guarantee all-bump assembly
Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder.
Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks
quiz.explanation: 阻障層與焊料帽在接合中參與擴散與反應；只報總凸塊高會掩蓋各層厚度不足。 量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 因此不能採用「總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查」。
quiz.explanationEn: Barrier and solder cap participate in diffusion and reaction; reporting total bump height hides deficient individual layers. Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. Therefore reject: Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks.

steps.title: 去種子層與側蝕｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Seed removal and undercut | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對去種子層與側蝕，把「移除導通背景需避免柱底側蝕；短路消失與機械根部完整是兩個不同驗收條件。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for seed removal and undercut: Removing the conductive background must limit base undercut; eliminating shorts and preserving the mechanical root are separate criteria. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Pair isolation tests with pillar-root cross-sections in both sparse and dense regions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 配對絕緣測試與柱根截面，在大間距和密集區各取樣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：絕緣通過即可忽略柱根側蝕。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.title: 電阻與電流密度｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Resistance and current density | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對電阻與電流密度，把「柱身 R=ρL/A 只描述幾何導體；量測電阻還含接觸與引線，局部狹頸的 J 高於平均。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For resistance and current density, turn "R=ρL/A describes the pillar body only; measured resistance includes contacts and leads, while a neck has higher J than the average." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「電阻與電流密度」的模型：柱身 R=ρL/A 只描述幾何導體；量測電阻還含接觸與引線，局部狹頸的 J 高於平均。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「做四端與兩端比較，將幾何推算值同實測差額列成未知界面項。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設銅柱直徑 20 μm、長 40 μm、ρ=1.7×10⁻⁸ Ω·m：R=ρL/A≈2.16 mΩ。10 mA 對應 J≈3.18×10⁷ A/m²；忽略接觸、尺寸效應與溫升，不能據此宣稱安全電流。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for resistance and current density: R=ρL/A describes the pillar body only; measured resistance includes contacts and leads, while a neck has higher J than the average. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare four- and two-terminal results and record excess measured resistance as an unresolved interface term. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For an illustrative 20 μm diameter, 40 μm long Cu pillar with ρ=1.7×10⁻⁸ Ω·m, R=ρL/A≈2.16 mΩ. At 10 mA, J≈3.18×10⁷ A/m². Contact resistance, size effects and heating are omitted, so this does not establish a safe current. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 做四端與兩端比較，將幾何推算值同實測差額列成未知界面項。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare four- and two-terminal results and record excess measured resistance as an unresolved interface term. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩端電阻可直接反推純銅電阻率。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Directly inferring pure-Cu resistivity from two-terminal resistance. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付電阻與電流密度的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for resistance and current density, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: R=ρL/A describes the pillar body only; measured resistance includes contacts and leads, while a neck has higher J than the average.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 做四端與兩端比較，將幾何推算值同實測差額列成未知界面項。 必須排除的錯判：兩端電阻可直接反推純銅電阻率。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare four- and two-terminal results and record excess measured resistance as an unresolved interface term. Misinterpretation to reject: Directly inferring pure-Cu resistivity from two-terminal resistance. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.text: 假設銅柱直徑 20 μm、長 40 μm、ρ=1.7×10⁻⁸ Ω·m：R=ρL/A≈2.16 mΩ。10 mA 對應 J≈3.18×10⁷ A/m²；忽略接觸、尺寸效應與溫升，不能據此宣稱安全電流。
knowledge.textEn: For an illustrative 20 μm diameter, 40 μm long Cu pillar with ρ=1.7×10⁻⁸ Ω·m, R=ρL/A≈2.16 mΩ. At 10 mA, J≈3.18×10⁷ A/m². Contact resistance, size effects and heating are omitted, so this does not establish a safe current.

stages.description: 針對量測與可靠度放行完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for metrology and reliability release, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 剪切測試的破壞位置｜機制與設計

steps.title: 電遷移與溫升分辨｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Separate electromigration and heating | mechanism and design

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for separate electromigration and heating: Resistance drift can reflect reversible heating or irreversible voiding; preserve current polarity and thermal history. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare resistance recovery after cooling and failure location, first excluding probe drift. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較冷卻後阻值恢復與失效端位置，先排除量測接點飄移。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare resistance recovery after cooling and failure location, first excluding probe drift. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：通電中電阻上升只能是電遷移。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

courses.title: 熱壓接合
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入力—熱—位移耦合與接合後界面。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore force–temperature–displacement coupling and bonded interfaces, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 接觸設計
stages.description: 針對接觸設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for contact design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 接合堆疊剖面｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對接合堆疊剖面，把「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For bond-stack cross-section, turn "Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「接合堆疊剖面」的模型：上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for bond-stack cross-section: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接合堆疊剖面的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for bond-stack cross-section, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Use this evidence plan: Compare witness-interface and tool-temperature traces with calibration location and uncertainty. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

courses.title: 直接銅對銅接合
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入銅表面形貌、接觸形成與界面電阻。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore copper topography, contact formation and interface resistance, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 表面與界面設計
stages.description: 針對表面與界面設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for surface and interface design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.objectiveEn: For separate cu and dielectric interfaces, turn "Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for separate cu and dielectric interfaces: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. steps.failure: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.objectiveEn: For cu recess and protrusion, turn "Metal height relative to surroundings determines initial contact and local load; mean flatness does not guarantee all-pad contact." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：以跨焊墊線掃描量相對高度，記錄相鄰介電質作基準的方法。 將「全片翹曲小即可不量局部銅凹陷」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Measure cross-pad height relative to adjacent dielectric and document the reference plane. Challenge the hypothesis "Ignoring local Cu recess when wafer warpage is small" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 以跨焊墊線掃描量相對高度，記錄相鄰介電質作基準的方法。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure cross-pad height relative to adjacent dielectric and document the reference plane. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：全片翹曲小即可不量局部銅凹陷。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring local Cu recess when wafer warpage is small. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付銅凹陷與突出的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for cu recess and protrusion: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for overlap-area budget: Overlay reduces conducting area and increases crowding; rotational error grows farther from the center. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Calculate pad-intersection areas from measured vectors and compare center and corners. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.failure: 避免：中心對位合格即可推論四角重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring corner overlap from a passing center alignment. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付重疊面積預算的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.objectiveEn: For real contact and plasticity, turn "Asperities touch first; local plasticity and diffusion evolve the interface, beyond nominal-pressure descriptions." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「真實接觸與塑性」的模型：粗糙峰先接觸，局部塑性及擴散會改變界面；名義壓力不足以描述接觸演化。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較載入前後形貌、接觸電阻與殘餘印痕，用同幾何對照件。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for real contact and plasticity: Asperities touch first; local plasticity and diffusion evolve the interface, beyond nominal-pressure descriptions. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare pre/post-load topography, resistance and residual impressions using matched geometries. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較載入前後形貌、接觸電阻與殘餘印痕，用同幾何對照件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare pre/post-load topography, resistance and residual impressions using matched geometries. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：提高名義壓力必定線性降低接觸電阻。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：先後量測冷態電阻、通電溫升與裂紋，保留試驗順序。 將「分開通過機械和電性測試就可忽略耦合」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Measure cold resistance, powered temperature rise and cracking while preserving test order. Challenge the hypothesis "Ignoring coupling after separate mechanical and electrical passes" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 先後量測冷態電阻、通電溫升與裂紋，保留試驗順序。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure cold resistance, powered temperature rise and cracking while preserving test order. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：分開通過機械和電性測試就可忽略耦合。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring coupling after separate mechanical and electrical passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付熱循環與電流耦合的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for thermal cycling and current coupling: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

courses.title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入已知良品、局部對位與混合介面。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore known-good die, local overlay and hybrid interfaces, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 晶粒輸入
stages.description: 針對晶粒輸入完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for die inputs, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.objectiveEn: For known-good-die confidence, turn "Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「已知良品置信度」的模型：測試覆蓋率與逃逸率決定選片可信度，通過並非零缺陷。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for known-good-die confidence: Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：把前測通過當成永久良品。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.objective: 針對切割後表面，把「切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For post-singulation surfaces, turn "Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「切割後表面」的模型：切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for post-singulation surfaces: Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare particle and void maps spatially. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付切割後表面的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for post-singulation surfaces, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 切割後表面：機制
knowledge.text: 切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。
knowledge.textEn: Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 必須排除的錯判：顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「切割後表面」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For post-singulation surfaces — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險
只看最終位置即可判斷接合完整
切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。
optionsEn: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk
Inferring bond completeness from final position
Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately.
quiz.explanation: 切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。 對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 因此不能採用「顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險」。
quiz.explanationEn: Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately. Compare particle and void maps spatially. Therefore reject: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk.

steps.title: 切割後表面｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對切割後表面，把「切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For post-singulation surfaces, turn "Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 將「顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付切割後表面的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for post-singulation surfaces: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.objective: 針對局部銅凹陷，把「單顆晶粒的焊墊高度分布影響接觸，晶圓平均不能替代逐顆尾端風險。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For local cu recess, turn "Per-die pad-height distribution controls contact; wafer means hide die-level tails." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.

Use this evidence plan: Measure pad-relative height at center and corners. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

courses.title: 晶粒對晶粒堆疊
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入堆疊拓撲、累積誤差與可測性。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore stack topology, accumulated error and testability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 堆疊定義
stages.description: 針對堆疊定義完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for stack definition, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 面向與拓撲｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Orientation and topology | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對面向與拓撲，把「面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For orientation and topology, turn "Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「面向與拓撲」的模型：面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫每層訊號、電源和背面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for orientation and topology: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付面向與拓撲的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for orientation and topology, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.text: 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 必須排除的錯判：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Misinterpretation to reject: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

steps.title: 面向與拓撲｜證據與診斷

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Challenge the hypothesis "Reusing one net map for every orientation" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付面向與拓撲的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for orientation and topology: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 已知良品序列｜機制與設計

steps.check: 交付逐層對位的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for layer-by-layer overlay: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 逐層對位：機制
knowledge.text: 相對每層對準不保證對共同基準的累積誤差小。
knowledge.textEn: Good adjacent-layer overlay need not ensure small error to a common datum.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨

knowledge.textEn: Plot adjacent-layer and common-datum errors. Misinterpretation to reject: Ignoring global drift when individual shifts are small. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「逐層對位」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For layer-by-layer overlay — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?

同時繪相鄰誤差與全堆疊基準誤差。

Plot adjacent-layer and common-datum errors.

stages.title: 跨層驗證

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for cross-layer verification, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 接合界面抽樣｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對接合界面抽樣，把「埋藏層的取樣可接近性隨堆疊改變，須預留見證結構。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「接合界面抽樣」的模型：埋藏層的取樣可接近性隨堆疊改變，須預留見證結構。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「列每一界面的可測量與盲區。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for interface sampling: Buried-interface access changes during stacking; reserve witness structures. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List measurable quantities and blind spots per interface. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 列每一界面的可測量與盲區。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.check: 交付接合界面抽樣的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for interface sampling, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

先研磨到可見裂紋再作電測最有效

Using top-layer images for every buried interface

steps.title: 跨層供電｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Vertical power delivery | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對跨層供電，把「多層電流匯流造成不同 TSV 和接點電流負載。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For vertical power delivery, turn "Summed layer currents impose unequal TSV and joint loading." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「跨層供電」的模型：多層電流匯流造成不同 TSV 和接點電流負載。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「依每層功耗畫垂直電流樹。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for vertical power delivery: Summed layer currents impose unequal TSV and joint loading. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw a vertical current tree from layer power. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 依每層功耗畫垂直電流樹。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw a vertical current tree from layer power. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有層用電相同即各 TSV 同電流。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal layer power gives equal TSV currents. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付跨層供電的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for vertical power delivery, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.text: 多層電流匯流造成不同 TSV 和接點電流負載。
knowledge.textEn: Summed layer currents impose unequal TSV and joint loading.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 依每層功耗畫垂直電流樹。 必須排除的錯判：所有層用電相同即各 TSV 同電流。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a vertical current tree from layer power. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming equal layer power gives equal TSV currents. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「跨層供電」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For vertical power delivery — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 所有層用電相同即各 TSV 同電流
所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖
多層電流匯流造成不同 TSV 和接點電流負載。
optionsEn: Assuming equal layer power gives equal TSV currents
Reusing one net map for every orientation
Summed layer currents impose unequal TSV and joint loading.
quiz.explanation: 多層電流匯流造成不同 TSV 和接點電流負載。 依每層功耗畫垂直電流樹。 因此不能採用「所有層用電相同即各 TSV 同電流」。
quiz.explanationEn: Summed layer currents impose unequal TSV and joint loading. Draw a vertical current tree from layer power. Therefore reject: Assuming equal layer power gives equal TSV currents.

steps.title: 測試存取｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對測試存取，把「埋藏邏輯需設計可觀測和可控制路徑，邊界測試不等於完整功能測試。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For test access, turn "Buried logic needs observable and controllable paths; boundary testing is not full functionality." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「測試存取」的模型：埋藏邏輯需設計可觀測和可控制路徑，邊界測試不等於完整功能測試。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較連通測試、記憶體測試與功能測試覆蓋。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設 8 層厚度各 50±1 μm，獨立標準差的總厚不確定度 √8≈2.83 μm；若每層有同向 1 μm 系統偏差，總偏差為 8 μm，不能用 RSS 消除。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for test access: Buried logic needs observable and controllable paths; boundary testing is not full functionality. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare continuity, memory and functional coverage. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: Eight illustrative 50±1 μm layers give √8≈2.83 μm total standard uncertainty if independent. A same-sign 1 μm systematic bias per layer instead adds to 8 μm. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 比較連通測試、記憶體測試與功能測試覆蓋。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare continuity, memory and functional coverage. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：邊界鏈路通過即所有邏輯功能正常。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating boundary-chain success with all logic functionality. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付測試存取的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for test access, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

courses.title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入載板支撐、黏著窗口與低損傷解接合。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore carrier support, adhesion window and low-damage release, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與路徑

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for materials and routes, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

knowledge.textEn: Thermal-slide, UV and IR release act at different layers and boundaries.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 把吸收層、透明路徑和支撐面標到剖面。 必須排除的錯判：各種解接合只差光源名稱。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Mark absorbers, optical paths and supports in section. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating release routes as interchangeable light-source labels. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「釋放路徑比較」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For release-route comparison — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 把吸收層、透明路徑和支撐面標到剖面。
各種解接合只差光源名稱
外觀無裂紋即證明材料相容
optionsEn: Mark absorbers, optical paths and supports in section.
Treating release routes as interchangeable light-source labels
Using crack-free appearance as compatibility proof
quiz.explanation: 熱滑移、UV 與 IR 釋放的作用層和設備邊界不同。 把吸收層、透明路徑和支撐面標到剖面。 因此不能採用「各種解接合只差光源名稱」。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal-slide, UV and IR release act at different layers and boundaries. Mark absorbers, optical paths and supports in section. Therefore reject: Treating release routes as interchangeable light-source labels.

steps.title: 膠層厚度地圖｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Adhesive thickness map | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對膠層厚度地圖，把「膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For adhesive thickness map, turn "Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「膠層厚度地圖」的模型：膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for adhesive thickness map: Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付膠層厚度地圖的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for adhesive thickness map, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 膠層厚度地圖：機制
knowledge.text: 膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 必須排除的錯判：總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Misinterpretation to reject: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「膠層厚度地圖」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For adhesive thickness map — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 厚度減半僅讓剛性減半
膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。
總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻
optionsEn: Assuming half thickness means half stiffness
Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors.
Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness
quiz.explanation: 膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 因此不能採用「總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻」。
quiz.explanationEn: Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors. Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Therefore reject: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness.

steps.title: 膠層厚度地圖｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesive thickness map | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對膠層厚度地圖，把「膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For adhesive thickness map, turn "Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 將「總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Challenge the hypothesis "Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付膠層厚度地圖的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for adhesive thickness map: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 暫時接合
stages.description: 針對暫時接合完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for temporary bonding, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 空洞與氣泡｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Voids and bubbles | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對空洞與氣泡，把「未接合空洞降低局部剛性，背面載荷可放大變形。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For voids and bubbles, turn "Bond voids reduce local stiffness, amplifying backside-load deformation." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「空洞與氣泡」的模型：未接合空洞降低局部剛性，背面載荷可放大變形。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將空洞圖與薄化後厚度圖配準。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for voids and bubbles: Bond voids reduce local stiffness, amplifying backside-load deformation. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Register void and post-thinning thickness maps. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將空洞圖與薄化後厚度圖配準。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Register void and post-thinning thickness maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：小空洞在所有後續步驟都無影響。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming small voids never matter downstream. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付空洞與氣泡的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for voids and bubbles, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

courses.title: 晶圓薄化與背面研磨
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入薄化幾何、次表面損傷與薄片支撐。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thinning geometry, subsurface damage and thin-wafer support, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

knowledge.textEn: Compare removal per station with damage sections. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating smooth surfaces with no subsurface cracks. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「粗磨與細磨」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For coarse and fine grinding — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 厚環支撐等同全片均勻厚度
對照逐站移除量與截面損傷。
最後表面光滑就無次表面裂紋
optionsEn: Treating ring-supported wafers as uniformly thick
Compare removal per station with damage sections.
Equating smooth surfaces with no subsurface cracks
quiz.explanation: 移除效率和損傷深度互相牽制，細磨不保證去除全部粗磨損傷。 對照逐站移除量與截面損傷。 因此不能採用「最後表面光滑就無次表面裂紋」。
quiz.explanationEn: Removal rate trades against damage depth; fine grinding need not remove all coarse damage. Compare removal per station with damage sections. Therefore reject: Equating smooth surfaces with no subsurface cracks.

steps.title: 載荷與輪痕｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Loads and wheel marks | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對載荷與輪痕，把「輪痕方向與局部負載可留下應力各向異性。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For loads and wheel marks, turn "Wheel-mark direction and local loads can create anisotropic stress." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「載荷與輪痕」的模型：輪痕方向與局部負載可留下應力各向異性。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「按徑向和切向取樣比較強度。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for loads and wheel marks: Wheel-mark direction and local loads can create anisotropic stress. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare radial and tangential strength sampling. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 按徑向和切向取樣比較強度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare radial and tangential strength sampling. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有方向的彎曲強度可視為相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal bending strength in every direction. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付載荷與輪痕的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for loads and wheel marks, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

options: 所有方向的彎曲強度可視為相同
最高強度樣本可代表整批可靠度
輪痕方向與局部負載可留下應力各向異性。

Using the strongest sample to represent lot reliability

steps.title: 載荷與輪痕｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Loads and wheel marks | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對載荷與輪痕，把「輪痕方向與局部負載可留下應力各向異性。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For loads and wheel marks, turn "Wheel-mark direction and local loads can create anisotropic stress." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：按徑向和切向取樣比較強度。 將「所有方向的彎曲強度可視為相同」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare radial and tangential strength sampling. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming equal bending strength in every direction" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 按徑向和切向取樣比較強度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare radial and tangential strength sampling. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有方向的彎曲強度可視為相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal bending strength in every direction. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付載荷與輪痕的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for loads and wheel marks: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 厚度量測基準｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對厚度量測基準，把「透明保護層、背面反射與探頭校正會影響厚度讀值。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.failure: 避免：最高強度樣本可代表整批可靠度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for fracture statistics: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

courses.title: 雷射隱形切割
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入內部改質層、裂紋傳播與薄晶粒強度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore internal modified layers, crack propagation and thin-die strength, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與路徑
stages.description: 針對材料與路徑完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for material and path, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

knowledge.textEn: Use unseparated segments to evaluate continuity. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating invisible surface marks as failed modification. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「改質連續性」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For modification continuity — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 表面看不見痕跡即表示改質失敗
機械分離成功即電性一定不變
以分離後未斷區反推改質連續性。
optionsEn: Treating invisible surface marks as failed modification
Assuming successful separation preserves electrical behavior
Use unseparated segments to evaluate continuity.
quiz.explanation: 不連續弱化區可能造成未分離或偏折裂紋。 以分離後未斷區反推改質連續性。 因此不能採用「表面看不見痕跡即表示改質失敗」。
quiz.explanationEn: Discontinuous weakening can cause incomplete separation or deflection. Use unseparated segments to evaluate continuity. Therefore reject: Treating invisible surface marks as failed modification.

stages.title: 分離與邊緣
stages.description: 針對分離與邊緣完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for separation and edges, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 研磨前後順序｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對研磨前後順序，把「SDBG 的加工順序使研磨和裂紋發展共同影響最後邊緣。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For grinding order, turn "SDBG couples grinding and crack evolution through process order." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「研磨前後順序」的模型：SDBG 的加工順序使研磨和裂紋發展共同影響最後邊緣。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較先薄化與後薄化兩條流程。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for grinding order: SDBG couples grinding and crack evolution through process order. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare thin-first and thin-later flows. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較先薄化與後薄化兩條流程。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare thin-first and thin-later flows. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：交換順序不影響薄晶粒強度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming order never affects thin-die strength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付研磨前後順序的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for grinding order, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

quiz.question: 在「研磨前後順序」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For grinding order — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: SDBG 的加工順序使研磨和裂紋發展共同影響最後邊緣。
交換順序不影響薄晶粒強度
已驗證矽流程可直接套用所有複合晶片
optionsEn: SDBG couples grinding and crack evolution through process order.
Assuming order never affects thin-die strength
Transferring a qualified silicon flow to every composite die
quiz.explanation: SDBG 的加工順序使研磨和裂紋發展共同影響最後邊緣。 比較先薄化與後薄化兩條流程。 因此不能採用「交換順序不影響薄晶粒強度」。
quiz.explanationEn: SDBG couples grinding and crack evolution through process order. Compare thin-first and thin-later flows. Therefore reject: Assuming order never affects thin-die strength.

steps.title: 研磨前後順序｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對研磨前後順序，把「SDBG 的加工順序使研磨和裂紋發展共同影響最後邊緣。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For grinding order, turn "SDBG couples grinding and crack evolution through process order." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較先薄化與後薄化兩條流程。 將「交換順序不影響薄晶粒強度」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare thin-first and thin-later flows. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming order never affects thin-die strength" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較先薄化與後薄化兩條流程。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare thin-first and thin-later flows. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：交換順序不影響薄晶粒強度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming order never affects thin-die strength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付研磨前後順序的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for grinding order: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 膜框擴張｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對膜框擴張，把「膜框擴張把載荷傳入街道，非均勻張力可造成不同分離量。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For tape expansion, turn "Tape expansion loads streets; uneven tension causes uneven separation." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「膜框擴張」的模型：膜框擴張把載荷傳入街道，非均勻張力可造成不同分離量。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「量中心與邊緣晶粒間隙和旋轉。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for tape expansion: Tape expansion loads streets; uneven tension causes uneven separation. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Measure center/edge die gaps and rotation. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 量中心與邊緣晶粒間隙和旋轉。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：擴張距離相同即每條街道受力相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

膜框擴張把載荷傳入街道，非均勻張力可造成不同分離量。

steps.title: 崩邊與裂紋深度｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Chipping and crack depth | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對崩邊與裂紋深度，把「邊緣外觀只顯示表面，次表面裂紋仍可能控制抗折強度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For chipping and crack depth, turn "Edge appearance shows the surface; subsurface cracks may control strength." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「崩邊與裂紋深度」的模型：邊緣外觀只顯示表面，次表面裂紋仍可能控制抗折強度。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設街道寬 40 μm、對準誤差界限 ±3 μm、受影響區寬 12 μm，單側理想幾何餘量為 (40−12)/2−3=11 μm；還未包含裂紋偏折和保護區。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for chipping and crack depth: Edge appearance shows the surface; subsurface cracks may control strength. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For a hypothetical 40 μm street, ±3 μm alignment bound and 12 μm affected zone, one-sided geometric margin is (40−12)/2−3=11 μm before crack deviation and keep-outs. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付崩邊與裂紋深度的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for chipping and crack depth, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

quiz.questionEn: For chipping and crack depth — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 街道中心對準就無需保護餘量

steps.title: 崩邊與裂紋深度｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Chipping and crack depth | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對崩邊與裂紋深度，把「邊緣外觀只顯示表面，次表面裂紋仍可能控制抗折強度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For chipping and crack depth, turn "Edge appearance shows the surface; subsurface cracks may control strength." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。 將「無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。 原創算例：假設街道寬 40 μm、對準誤差界限 ±3 μm、受影響區寬 12 μm，單側理想幾何餘量為 (40−12)/2−3=11 μm；還未包含裂紋偏折和保護區。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition. Original example: For a hypothetical 40 μm street, ±3 μm alignment bound and 12 μm affected zone, one-sided geometric margin is (40−12)/2−3=11 μm before crack deviation and keep-outs. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付崩邊與裂紋深度的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for chipping and crack depth: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 崩邊與裂紋深度：機制
knowledge.text: 邊緣外觀只顯示表面，次表面裂紋仍可能控制抗折強度。
knowledge.textEn: Edge appearance shows the surface; subsurface cracks may control strength.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。 必須排除的錯判：無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設街道寬 40 μm、對準誤差界限 ±3 μm、受影響區寬 12 μm，單側理想幾何餘量為 (40−12)/2−3=11 μm；還未包含裂紋偏折和保護區。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical 40 μm street, ±3 μm alignment bound and 12 μm affected zone, one-sided geometric margin is (40−12)/2−3=11 μm before crack deviation and keep-outs.

quiz.question: 在「崩邊與裂紋深度」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For chipping and crack depth — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋
街道中心對準就無需保護餘量
結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。
optionsEn: Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks
Omitting keep-out margin after center alignment
Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests.
quiz.explanation: 邊緣外觀只顯示表面，次表面裂紋仍可能控制抗折強度。 結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。 因此不能採用「無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋」。
quiz.explanationEn: Edge appearance shows the surface; subsurface cracks may control strength. Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. Therefore reject: Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks.

stages.title: 驗證與整合
stages.description: 針對驗證與整合完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for validation and integration, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 粒子與拾取｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Particles and pickup | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對粒子與拾取，把「分離後顆粒與膜黏著會影響後續高潔淨接合。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For particles and pickup, turn "Post-separation particles and tape adhesion affect clean bonding." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「粒子與拾取」的模型：分離後顆粒與膜黏著會影響後續高潔淨接合。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較拾取前後顆粒和晶粒面向。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for particles and pickup: Post-separation particles and tape adhesion affect clean bonding. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare particles and orientation before/after pickup. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較拾取前後顆粒和晶粒面向。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare particles and orientation before/after pickup. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：無鋸屑就可省略顆粒檢測。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping particle inspection because there is no sawdust. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付粒子與拾取的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for particles and pickup, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.
