courses.title: 電漿晶圓切割
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入遮罩、深蝕刻及膜框熱邊界。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore masking, deep etch and frame thermal boundaries, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for singulation design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List the layer stack in each street. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.observation: 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：保持試片厚度與加載方向一致。 將「電漿切割必定讓所有晶粒同等強」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Keep specimen thickness and loading direction matched. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming plasma dicing gives identical strength to every die" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. steps.observation: 保持試片厚度與加載方向一致。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Keep specimen thickness and loading direction matched. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：電漿切割必定讓所有晶粒同等強。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for die strength: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 晶粒強度：機制

電漿切割必定讓所有晶粒同等強
膜框能入腔就代表材料已相容

Assuming plasma dicing gives identical strength to every die
Equating chamber fit with material compatibility

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for yield and throughput: Parallel singulation benefits must include masking and cleaning time. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Calculate full-route time and cost per good die. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 計算完整路徑時間與每良品成本。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failureEn: Avoid: Comparing cost using chamber time alone. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付良率與節拍的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for yield and throughput, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

courses.title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入薄晶粒取放、座標轉換與受力保護。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thin-die handling, coordinate transforms and load protection, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 晶粒輸入

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for die input, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入毛細流動、填料與固化應力。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore capillary flow, fillers and cure stress, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

steps.objective: 針對焊點與通道，把「陣列方向改變流阻與毛細旁路，流量不均可繞過密集區。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For joints and channels, turn "Array direction alters resistance and bypass paths; flow can skip dense regions." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較沿列與斜向流動示意。 將「看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. Challenge the hypothesis "Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較沿列與斜向流動示意。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付焊點與通道的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for joints and channels: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 焊點與通道：機制
knowledge.text: 陣列方向改變流阻與毛細旁路，流量不均可繞過密集區。
knowledge.textEn: Array direction alters resistance and bypass paths; flow can skip dense regions.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較沿列與斜向流動示意。 必須排除的錯判：看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. Misinterpretation to reject: Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「焊點與通道」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For joints and channels — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 填滿且固化即滿足所有封裝需求
比較沿列與斜向流動示意。
看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿
optionsEn: Assuming filled and cured meets every package need
Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow.
Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill
quiz.explanation: 陣列方向改變流阻與毛細旁路，流量不均可繞過密集區。 比較沿列與斜向流動示意。 因此不能採用「看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿」。
quiz.explanationEn: Array direction alters resistance and bypass paths; flow can skip dense regions. Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. Therefore reject: Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill.

steps.title: 固化收縮｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對固化收縮，把「固化增加模數並帶來收縮，拘束條件決定殘餘應力。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For cure shrinkage, turn "Cure increases modulus and introduces shrinkage; constraints set residual stress." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「固化收縮」的模型：固化增加模數並帶來收縮，拘束條件決定殘餘應力。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較自由收縮與接合堆疊變形。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for cure shrinkage: Cure increases modulus and introduces shrinkage; constraints set residual stress. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare free shrinkage and bonded-stack deformation. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較自由收縮與接合堆疊變形。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare free shrinkage and bonded-stack deformation. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：固化收縮只會改體積不會改應力。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming cure shrinkage changes volume but not stress. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付固化收縮的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for cure shrinkage, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 固化收縮：機制
knowledge.text: 固化增加模數並帶來收縮，拘束條件決定殘餘應力。
knowledge.textEn: Cure increases modulus and introduces shrinkage; constraints set residual stress.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較自由收縮與接合堆疊變形。 必須排除的錯判：固化收縮只會改體積不會改應力。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare free shrinkage and bonded-stack deformation. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming cure shrinkage changes volume but not stress. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「固化收縮」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For cure shrinkage — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 固化收縮只會改體積不會改應力
平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間
固化增加模數並帶來收縮，拘束條件決定殘餘應力。
optionsEn: Assuming cure shrinkage changes volume but not stress
Using mean gap to predict every fill time
Cure increases modulus and introduces shrinkage; constraints set residual stress.
quiz.explanation: 固化增加模數並帶來收縮，拘束條件決定殘餘應力。 比較自由收縮與接合堆疊變形。 因此不能採用「固化收縮只會改體積不會改應力」。
quiz.explanationEn: Cure increases modulus and introduces shrinkage; constraints set residual stress. Compare free shrinkage and bonded-stack deformation. Therefore reject: Assuming cure shrinkage changes volume but not stress.

steps.title: Tg 與 CTE｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Tg and CTE | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對Tg 與 CTE，把「玻璃轉移附近模數和膨脹行為改變，不能用單一常數跨全溫域。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For tg and cte, turn "Modulus and expansion change near glass transition; one constant may not span temperatures." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「Tg 與 CTE」的模型：玻璃轉移附近模數和膨脹行為改變，不能用單一常數跨全溫域。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把材料曲線與使用溫度範圍疊合。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：在平行板、牛頓流體且忽略重力的教學尺度模型中 L²∝hγcosθ·t/μ；流長加倍需約四倍時間，黏度加倍需約兩倍時間。真實凸塊和填料會改變此關係。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for tg and cte: Modulus and expansion change near glass transition; one constant may not span temperatures. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Overlay material curves and operating range. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For a Newtonian liquid between parallel plates, neglecting gravity, L²∝hγcosθ·t/μ: doubling length takes about four times as long and doubling viscosity twice as long. Bumps and fillers modify the relation. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 把材料曲線與使用溫度範圍疊合。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Overlay material curves and operating range. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：Tg 越高便無條件越可靠。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming higher Tg is unconditionally more reliable. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Tg 與 CTE的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for tg and cte, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

quiz.questionEn: For tg and cte — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面

Tg 越高便無條件越可靠
optionsEn: Applying handbook contact angles to every surface

stages.title: 檢測可靠度
stages.description: 針對檢測可靠度完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for inspection and reliability, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 空洞量測｜機制與設計

courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入模封收縮、材料非線性與翹曲。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore mold shrinkage, material nonlinearity and warpage, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料表徵
stages.description: 針對材料表徵完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for material characterization, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 材料組成｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對材料組成，把「樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For material composition, turn "Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「材料組成」的模型：樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將材料批次連到實測曲線。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for material composition: Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Link material lots to measured curves. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將材料批次連到實測曲線。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Link material lots to measured curves. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：相同填料百分比必有相同模數。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating filler percentage with modulus. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付材料組成的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for material composition, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 材料組成：機制
knowledge.text: 樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。
knowledge.textEn: Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 將材料批次連到實測曲線。 必須排除的錯判：相同填料百分比必有相同模數。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Link material lots to measured curves. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating filler percentage with modulus. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「材料組成」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For material composition — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。
相同填料百分比必有相同模數
所有收縮都可用 CTE·ΔT 描述
optionsEn: Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics.
Equating filler percentage with modulus
Describing all shrinkage with CTE·ΔT
quiz.explanation: 樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。 將材料批次連到實測曲線。 因此不能採用「相同填料百分比必有相同模數」。
quiz.explanationEn: Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics. Link material lots to measured curves. Therefore reject: Equating filler percentage with modulus.

steps.title: 材料組成｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對材料組成，把「樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For material composition, turn "Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：將材料批次連到實測曲線。 將「相同填料百分比必有相同模數」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Link material lots to measured curves. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating filler percentage with modulus" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 將材料批次連到實測曲線。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Link material lots to measured curves. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：相同填料百分比必有相同模數。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating filler percentage with modulus. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付材料組成的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for material composition: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

options: 最高溫度必是零應力參考
只需室溫翹曲驗收
追蹤凝膠、收縮與拘束開始。
optionsEn: Assuming peak temperature is stress-free
Qualifying warpage at room temperature only
Track gelation, shrinkage and constraint onset.
quiz.explanation: 應力自由態並不一定是最高加工溫度。 追蹤凝膠、收縮與拘束開始。 因此不能採用「最高溫度必是零應力參考」。
quiz.explanationEn: The stress-free state is not necessarily peak process temperature. Track gelation, shrinkage and constraint onset. Therefore reject: Assuming peak temperature is stress-free.

stages.title: 流動與固化
stages.description: 針對流動與固化完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for flow and curing, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 流動前沿｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對流動前沿，把「晶粒與高低台階改變前沿，可能留下焊線掃移或空洞。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For flow fronts, turn "Dies and steps alter fronts, causing wire sweep or voids." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「流動前沿」的模型：晶粒與高低台階改變前沿，可能留下焊線掃移或空洞。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把前沿圖與缺陷位置相連。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for flow fronts: Dies and steps alter fronts, causing wire sweep or voids. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Relate front maps to defect positions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 把前沿圖與缺陷位置相連。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Relate front maps to defect positions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：充滿模具即表示內部無空洞。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating a full mold with void-free interiors. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付流動前沿的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for flow fronts, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 流動前沿：機制

knowledge.textEn: Dies and steps alter fronts, causing wire sweep or voids.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 把前沿圖與缺陷位置相連。 必須排除的錯判：充滿模具即表示內部無空洞。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Relate front maps to defect positions. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating a full mold with void-free interiors. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「流動前沿」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For flow fronts — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 晶粒與高低台階改變前沿，可能留下焊線掃移或空洞。
充滿模具即表示內部無空洞
相同終溫必有相同殘應力
optionsEn: Dies and steps alter fronts, causing wire sweep or voids.
Equating a full mold with void-free interiors
Assuming equal final temperature gives equal residual stress
quiz.explanation: 晶粒與高低台階改變前沿，可能留下焊線掃移或空洞。 把前沿圖與缺陷位置相連。 因此不能採用「充滿模具即表示內部無空洞」。
quiz.explanationEn: Dies and steps alter fronts, causing wire sweep or voids. Relate front maps to defect positions. Therefore reject: Equating a full mold with void-free interiors.

steps.title: 流動前沿｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對流動前沿，把「晶粒與高低台階改變前沿，可能留下焊線掃移或空洞。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For flow fronts, turn "Dies and steps alter fronts, causing wire sweep or voids." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：把前沿圖與缺陷位置相連。 將「充滿模具即表示內部無空洞」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Relate front maps to defect positions. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating a full mold with void-free interiors" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 把前沿圖與缺陷位置相連。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Relate front maps to defect positions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：充滿模具即表示內部無空洞。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating a full mold with void-free interiors. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付流動前沿的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for flow fronts: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 填料偏析｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對填料偏析，把「局部填料變化使 CTE 和模數不均。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For filler segregation, turn "Local filler variation makes CTE/modulus nonuniform." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「填料偏析」的模型：局部填料變化使 CTE 和模數不均。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「沿流向和厚度比較截面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for filler segregation: Local filler variation makes CTE/modulus nonuniform. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare sections along flow and through thickness. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 沿流向和厚度比較截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare sections along flow and through thickness. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：整批配方相同就不可能局部翹曲差。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付填料偏析的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

options: 整批配方相同就不可能局部翹曲差

局部填料變化使 CTE 和模數不均。
optionsEn: Assuming one formulation excludes local warp variation
Inferring free flatness from clamped flatness
Local filler variation makes CTE/modulus nonuniform.

steps.check: 交付黏彈鬆弛的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for viscoelastic relaxation: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 黏彈鬆弛：機制
knowledge.text: 時間與溫度影響應力鬆弛，瞬間彈性模型有適用限。
knowledge.textEn: Time and temperature govern relaxation; instantaneous elasticity has limits.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較不同保溫時間的變形。 必須排除的錯判：相同終溫必有相同殘應力。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare deformation at different dwell durations. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming equal final temperature gives equal residual stress. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設自由材料 CTE 差 10 ppm/K、ΔT=100 K，失配應變為 0.001=0.1%。這不是封裝應力；要計算應力還需模數、泊松比、幾何、固化參考態及鬆弛。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical CTE difference of 10 ppm/K over 100 K gives mismatch strain 0.001=0.1%. Stress also needs modulus, Poisson ratio, geometry, cure reference state and relaxation.

quiz.question: 在「黏彈鬆弛」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？

室溫模數可代表整段固化
比較不同保溫時間的變形。
optionsEn: Assuming equal final temperature gives equal residual stress
Using room-temperature modulus throughout curing
Compare deformation at different dwell durations.

stages.title: 可靠度放行
stages.description: 針對可靠度放行完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。

steps.title: 量測支撐｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對量測支撐，把「夾持會壓平樣品並改變所量形状。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for measurement support: Clamping can flatten samples and change measured shape. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Record gravity orientation, supports and contact force. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.failure: 避免：夾持後平坦即證明自由狀態平坦。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付量測支撐的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for measurement support, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.titleEn: Delamination and moisture | mechanism and design

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。 將「擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付模型校準與交接的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for model calibration and handoff: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 模型校準與交接：機制
knowledge.text: 模型需用獨立條件驗證，擬合一條曲線不足以預測新堆疊。
knowledge.textEn: Validate on independent conditions; fitting one curve cannot establish transferability.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。 必須排除的錯判：擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「模型校準與交接」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For model calibration and handoff — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確
整批配方相同就不可能局部翹曲差
保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。
optionsEn: Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties
Assuming one formulation excludes local warp variation
Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation.
quiz.explanation: 模型需用獨立條件驗證，擬合一條曲線不足以預測新堆疊。 保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。 因此不能採用「擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確」。
quiz.explanationEn: Validate on independent conditions; fitting one curve cannot establish transferability. Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation. Therefore reject: Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties.

courses.title: 扇出型晶圓級封裝
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入重組晶圓、晶粒位移與 RDL 互連。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore reconstituted wafers, die shift and rdl interconnect, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 架構選擇
stages.description: 針對架構選擇完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for architecture selection, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for chip-first and chip-last: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Chip-first 與 chip-last的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for chip-first and chip-last, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.objective: 針對扇出面積配置，把「晶粒外增加配線區同時改變封裝尺寸與機械邊界。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.title: 載板與膠層｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Carrier and adhesive | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對載板與膠層，把「載板 CTE 和黏著改變模封後晶粒位移。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for carrier and adhesive: Carrier CTE and adhesion affect post-mold die shift. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare per-die positions before/after molding. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較模封前後逐顆位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare per-die positions before/after molding. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：初始放置精準就不會後續位移。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付載板與膠層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「跨材料 RDL」的模型：銅線跨越矽與模封邊界時承受局部失配應變。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「定位裂紋與晶粒邊緣的關係。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設重組後晶粒平移 4 μm，而 RDL 捕捉墊可允許 ±6 μm；留給曝光、熱變形與量測不確定度的合計餘量只剩 2 μm，不可把各站公差各自都設為 6 μm。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for cross-material rdl: Cu lines crossing Si/mold boundaries experience local mismatch strain. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Locate cracks relative to die edges. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: If illustrative die shift is 4 μm and the RDL capture allowance is ±6 μm, only 2 μm remains for exposure, thermal deformation and measurement uncertainty—not 6 μm at every station. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 定位裂紋與晶粒邊緣的關係。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：RDL 直流導通便不需熱循環。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping thermal cycling after RDL continuity passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付跨材料 RDL的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for cross-material rdl, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

courses.title: 扇出型面板級封裝
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入大面積均勻性、面板變形與拼接對位。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore large-area uniformity, panel distortion and stitching, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 面板布局
stages.description: 針對面板布局完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for panel layout, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Count grid placements rather than divide area alone. steps.observation: 用實際格點配置計數而非只除面積。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Count grid placements rather than divide area alone. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總面積除單位面積就是實際產量。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「晶粒分布」的模型：不均勻晶粒密度使模封流動和剛性有方向性。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for die distribution: Uneven die density makes mold flow and stiffness directional. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare central, edge and corner layouts. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare central, edge and corner layouts. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

knowledge.textEn: Small CTE differences create substantial nonrigid displacement over large scales.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 擬合平移旋轉後再看殘差場。 必須排除的錯判：一個全域平移可修正全部熱變形。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Fit rigid motion, then inspect residual fields. Misinterpretation to reject: Correcting all thermal distortion with one translation. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「熱變形場」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For thermal distortion field — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 一個全域平移可修正全部熱變形
面板翹曲合格就保證單顆翹曲合格
長尺度下小 CTE 差亦造成顯著非剛體位移。
optionsEn: Correcting all thermal distortion with one translation
Inferring package warpage from panel warpage
Small CTE differences create substantial nonrigid displacement over large scales.
quiz.explanation: 長尺度下小 CTE 差亦造成顯著非剛體位移。 擬合平移旋轉後再看殘差場。 因此不能採用「一個全域平移可修正全部熱變形」。
quiz.explanationEn: Small CTE differences create substantial nonrigid displacement over large scales. Fit rigid motion, then inspect residual fields. Therefore reject: Correcting all thermal distortion with one translation.

steps.title: 熱變形場｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal distortion field | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對熱變形場，把「長尺度下小 CTE 差亦造成顯著非剛體位移。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For thermal distortion field, turn "Small CTE differences create substantial nonrigid displacement over large scales." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：擬合平移旋轉後再看殘差場。 將「一個全域平移可修正全部熱變形」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Fit rigid motion, then inspect residual fields. Challenge the hypothesis "Correcting all thermal distortion with one translation" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 擬合平移旋轉後再看殘差場。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Fit rigid motion, then inspect residual fields. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：一個全域平移可修正全部熱變形。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Correcting all thermal distortion with one translation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付熱變形場的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for thermal distortion field: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 模封角落｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對模封角落，把「矩形角落的流動和應力邊界不同於中央。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For mold corners, turn "Rectangular corners have different flow/stress boundaries from centers." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「模封角落」的模型：矩形角落的流動和應力邊界不同於中央。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「單獨統計四角空洞和翹曲。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for mold corners: Rectangular corners have different flow/stress boundaries from centers. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Track corner voids and warpage separately. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 單獨統計四角空洞和翹曲。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Track corner voids and warpage separately. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：只採樣中心即可代表面板。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Sampling only the center to represent a panel. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付模封角落的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for mold corners, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

stages.title: 大面積圖形
stages.description: 針對大面積圖形完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for large-area patterning, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 曝光拼接｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對曝光拼接，把「曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For exposure stitching, turn "Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「曝光拼接」的模型：曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for exposure stitching: Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付曝光拼接的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for exposure stitching, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 曝光拼接：機制
knowledge.text: 曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。
knowledge.textEn: Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 必須排除的錯判：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「曝光拼接」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For exposure stitching — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。
每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題
面板越大成本必單調下降
optionsEn: Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control.
Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects
Assuming larger panels always lower unit cost
quiz.explanation: 曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。 跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 因此不能採用「每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題」。
quiz.explanationEn: Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control. Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Therefore reject: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects.

courses.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入細線 RDL、過孔連通與跨材料可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore fine rdl, via continuity and cross-material reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

courses.title: 嵌入式晶粒封裝
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入嵌入深度、雷射接點與層合可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore embedding depth, laser contacts and laminate reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 嵌入架構
stages.description: 針對嵌入架構完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for embedding architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 腔體與層疊｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Cavity and stackup | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對腔體與層疊，把「腔深與晶粒厚度決定上方介電質及平坦度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For cavity and stackup, turn "Cavity depth and die thickness set cover dielectric and flatness." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「腔體與層疊」的模型：腔深與晶粒厚度決定上方介電質及平坦度。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「列最壞組合的幾何界限。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for cavity and stackup: Cavity depth and die thickness set cover dielectric and flatness. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List worst-case geometry combinations. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 列最壞組合的幾何界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List worst-case geometry combinations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：名義腔深較大就不需公差分析。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付腔體與層疊的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for cavity and stackup, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 腔體與層疊：機制
knowledge.text: 腔深與晶粒厚度決定上方介電質及平坦度。
knowledge.textEn: Cavity depth and die thickness set cover dielectric and flatness.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 列最壞組合的幾何界限。 必須排除的錯判：名義腔深較大就不需公差分析。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: List worst-case geometry combinations. Misinterpretation to reject: Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「腔體與層疊」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For cavity and stackup — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 腔深與晶粒厚度決定上方介電質及平坦度。
名義腔深較大就不需公差分析
降低總壓力必能解決所有破片
optionsEn: Cavity depth and die thickness set cover dielectric and flatness.
Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger
Assuming lower pressure solves every fracture
quiz.explanation: 腔深與晶粒厚度決定上方介電質及平坦度。 列最壞組合的幾何界限。 因此不能採用「名義腔深較大就不需公差分析」。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavity depth and die thickness set cover dielectric and flatness. List worst-case geometry combinations. Therefore reject: Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger.

steps.title: 腔體與層疊｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Cavity and stackup | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對腔體與層疊，把「腔深與晶粒厚度決定上方介電質及平坦度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For cavity and stackup, turn "Cavity depth and die thickness set cover dielectric and flatness." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：列最壞組合的幾何界限。 將「名義腔深較大就不需公差分析」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: List worst-case geometry combinations. Challenge the hypothesis "Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 列最壞組合的幾何界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List worst-case geometry combinations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：名義腔深較大就不需公差分析。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付腔體與層疊的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for cavity and stackup: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 晶粒良品｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Known-good embedded die | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對晶粒良品，把「嵌入後返修受限，前測覆蓋影響整板成本。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For known-good embedded die, turn "Limited rework makes pretest coverage important to board cost." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「晶粒良品」的模型：嵌入後返修受限，前測覆蓋影響整板成本。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較前測投入與報廢層板風險。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for known-good embedded die: Limited rework makes pretest coverage important to board cost. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare screening effort and laminate scrap risk. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較前測投入與報廢層板風險。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare screening effort and laminate scrap risk. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：嵌入前測試可全由終測取代。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Replacing pre-embedding tests with final tests. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付晶粒良品的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for known-good embedded die, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: Compare screening effort and laminate scrap risk. Misinterpretation to reject: Replacing pre-embedding tests with final tests. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「晶粒良品」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For known-good embedded die — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 嵌入前測試可全由終測取代
外框標記對準即可保證所有埋藏墊
嵌入後返修受限，前測覆蓋影響整板成本。
optionsEn: Replacing pre-embedding tests with final tests
Using frame alignment to guarantee every buried pad
Limited rework makes pretest coverage important to board cost.
quiz.explanation: 嵌入後返修受限，前測覆蓋影響整板成本。 比較前測投入與報廢層板風險。 因此不能採用「嵌入前測試可全由終測取代」。
quiz.explanationEn: Limited rework makes pretest coverage important to board cost. Compare screening effort and laminate scrap risk. Therefore reject: Replacing pre-embedding tests with final tests.

stages.title: 放置與層合
stages.description: 針對放置與層合完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for placement and lamination, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 固定與位移｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Fixation and shift | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對固定與位移，把「層壓流動和壓力會讓晶粒平移或傾斜。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For fixation and shift, turn "Lamination flow/pressure can shift or tilt dies." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「固定與位移」的模型：層壓流動和壓力會讓晶粒平移或傾斜。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比對層壓前後 fiducial 位置。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for fixation and shift: Lamination flow/pressure can shift or tilt dies. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare fiducials before/after lamination. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比對層壓前後 fiducial 位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare fiducials before/after lamination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：放置精度就是最終嵌入精度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating placement with final embedding accuracy. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付固定與位移的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for fixation and shift, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.text: 比對層壓前後 fiducial 位置。 必須排除的錯判：放置精度就是最終嵌入精度。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare fiducials before/after lamination. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating placement with final embedding accuracy. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

steps.title: 固定與位移｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Fixation and shift | evidence and diagnosis

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比對層壓前後 fiducial 位置。 將「放置精度就是最終嵌入精度」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare fiducials before/after lamination. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating placement with final embedding accuracy" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比對層壓前後 fiducial 位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare fiducials before/after lamination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：放置精度就是最終嵌入精度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付固定與位移的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for fixation and shift: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

options: 板表面平整即內部無空洞
互連短就必定結溫較低
晶粒周圍狹縫可能形成樹脂不足與氣泡。

Assuming shorter interconnect guarantees lower junction temperature

steps.title: 開孔對位｜機制與設計

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for via-to-pad alignment: Buried pad locations depend on visible references and laminate distortion. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Retain local residuals and capture boundaries. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.check: 交付開孔對位的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.failure: 避免：外框標記對準即可保證所有埋藏墊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付開孔對位的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「金屬化連續」的模型：孔壁與焊墊的連續覆蓋決定垂直接點。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「用鏈路加局部截面定位不連續。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設晶粒厚 100±5 μm、腔深 120±4 μm，名義上方餘隙 20 μm；若公差為界限，最小餘隙 11 μm、最大 29 μm。RSS 只適用已知統計模型，不能替代最壞界限。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for metallization continuity: Continuous wall-to-pad coverage determines vertical connection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Use chains and local sections to locate discontinuity. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For a 100±5 μm die in a 120±4 μm cavity, nominal clearance is 20 μm and bounded extremes are 11–29 μm. RSS requires a statistical model and cannot replace worst-case bounds. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

knowledge.title: 金屬化連續：機制
knowledge.text: 孔壁與焊墊的連續覆蓋決定垂直接點。

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設晶粒厚 100±5 μm、腔深 120±4 μm，名義上方餘隙 20 μm；若公差為界限，最小餘隙 11 μm、最大 29 μm。RSS 只適用已知統計模型，不能替代最壞界限。

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：先定位網路再決定破壞性截面。 將「看到內部需要先研磨整板」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Localize nets before destructive sectioning. Challenge the hypothesis "Grinding the board before localization" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 先定位網路再決定破壞性截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Localize nets before destructive sectioning. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：看到內部需要先研磨整板。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Grinding the board before localization. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付測試與失效拆解的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for testing and failure analysis: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 測試與失效拆解：機制
knowledge.text: 埋藏元件需要設計測試節點及保留非破壞證據。
knowledge.textEn: Buried components need test access and retained nondestructive evidence.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 先定位網路再決定破壞性截面。 必須排除的錯判：看到內部需要先研磨整板。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Localize nets before destructive sectioning. Misinterpretation to reject: Grinding the board before localization. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「測試與失效拆解」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？

Inferring no internal voids from a flat board
Localize nets before destructive sectioning.

courses.title: 系統級封裝異質整合
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入功能分割、異質接口與系統驗證。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore functional partitioning, heterogeneous interfaces and system validation, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 系統分工
stages.description: 針對系統分工完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for system partition, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 功能需求樹｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Functional requirement tree | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對功能需求樹，把「系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For functional requirement tree, turn "System performance must become measurable module interfaces." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「功能需求樹」的模型：系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for functional requirement tree: System performance must become measurable module interfaces. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付功能需求樹的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for functional requirement tree, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.text: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 必須排除的錯判：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

options: 系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。
把功能元件放一起即成完整系統
各元件單獨熱測通過即可
optionsEn: System performance must become measurable module interfaces.
Equating colocated components with a complete system
Relying only on individual thermal passes
quiz.explanation: 系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 因此不能採用「把功能元件放一起即成完整系統」。

steps.title: 晶粒技術分工｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Die technology partition | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對晶粒技術分工，把「不同製程的優勢須抵銷封裝接口成本。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For die technology partition, turn "Process-node benefits must offset packaging-interface costs." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「晶粒技術分工」的模型：不同製程的優勢須抵銷封裝接口成本。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較單晶片與多晶粒的完整預算。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for die technology partition: Process-node benefits must offset packaging-interface costs. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare complete monolithic and multichip budgets. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較單晶片與多晶粒的完整預算。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare complete monolithic and multichip budgets. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：分割越多一定越省成本。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming more partitioning always lowers cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for system acceptance: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

courses.title: 矽穿孔蝕刻與絕緣
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入TSV 孔形、絕緣覆蓋與漏電。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore tsv geometry, insulation coverage and leakage, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 孔洞架構

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for via architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for via-first/middle/last: Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.observation: 估最壞遮罩消耗和對位界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for mask and keep-outs: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.objectiveEn: For bottom and corners, turn "Bottom corners affect coating continuity and local fields." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「孔底與轉角」的模型：孔底轉角影響沉積連續與局部場強。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「檢查最薄絕緣處而非平均厚度。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for bottom and corners: Bottom corners affect coating continuity and local fields. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 檢查最薄絕緣處而非平均厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均膜厚可排除所有擊穿弱點。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付孔底與轉角的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. Challenge the hypothesis "Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.

steps.observationEn: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均膜厚可排除所有擊穿弱點。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付孔底與轉角的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for bottom and corners: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.objectiveEn: For stress keep-out zone, turn "Post-fill mismatch can affect nearby devices; reserve space early." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。 將「孔外絕緣良好即可取消應力保護區」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare nearby and remote witness devices. Challenge the hypothesis "Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare nearby and remote witness devices. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：孔外絕緣良好即可取消應力保護區。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付應力保護區的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for stress keep-out zone: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 應力保護區：機制
knowledge.text: 填銅後熱失配可影響周邊元件，孔洞設計須提前保留區。
knowledge.textEn: Post-fill mismatch can affect nearby devices; reserve space early.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。 必須排除的錯判：孔外絕緣良好即可取消應力保護區。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare nearby and remote witness devices. Misinterpretation to reject: Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「應力保護區」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For stress keep-out zone — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。
孔外絕緣良好即可取消應力保護區
固定時間可保證每孔同深
optionsEn: Compare nearby and remote witness devices.
Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes
Assuming fixed time ensures equal depth
quiz.explanation: 填銅後熱失配可影響周邊元件，孔洞設計須提前保留區。 比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。 因此不能採用「孔外絕緣良好即可取消應力保護區」。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-fill mismatch can affect nearby devices; reserve space early. Compare nearby and remote witness devices. Therefore reject: Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes.

steps.title: 金屬化交接｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對金屬化交接，把「填充需要可覆蓋孔形、潔淨表面及已驗證絕緣。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For metallization handoff, turn "Filling requires coatable geometry, clean surfaces and qualified insulation." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「金屬化交接」的模型：填充需要可覆蓋孔形、潔淨表面及已驗證絕緣。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「提交孔形與漏電共同地圖。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for metallization handoff: Filling requires coatable geometry, clean surfaces and qualified insulation. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Deliver paired geometry/leakage maps. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 提交孔形與漏電共同地圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Deliver paired geometry/leakage maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：孔深達標即表示可直接填銅。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming target depth alone makes vias ready for Cu. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付金屬化交接的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for metallization handoff, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

courses.title: 矽穿孔金屬填充
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入阻障種子、成長前沿與空洞。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore barrier/seed, growth fronts and voids, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與孔形
stages.description: 針對材料與孔形完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for materials and geometry, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 導體選擇｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對導體選擇，把「Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For conductor selection, turn "Cu and W differ in resistivity, deposition and thermal mismatch." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「導體選擇」的模型：Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for conductor selection: Cu and W differ in resistivity, deposition and thermal mismatch. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare resistance and stress objectives. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare resistance and stress objectives. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：最低電阻材料必是每種 TSV 最佳選擇。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming lowest resistivity is always best. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付導體選擇的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for conductor selection, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: Compare void shape and height distribution. Misinterpretation to reject: Attributing every void to low plating current. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「潤濕與氣泡」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For wetting and bubbles — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成
低電阻即可免除空洞檢測
被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。
optionsEn: Attributing every void to low plating current
Skipping void inspection after low resistance
Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids.
quiz.explanation: 被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。 比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 因此不能採用「所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成」。
quiz.explanationEn: Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids. Compare void shape and height distribution. Therefore reject: Attributing every void to low plating current.

steps.title: 潤濕與氣泡｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Wetting and bubbles | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對潤濕與氣泡，把「被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For wetting and bubbles, turn "Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 將「所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare void shape and height distribution. Challenge the hypothesis "Attributing every void to low plating current" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare void shape and height distribution. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Attributing every void to low plating current. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付潤濕與氣泡的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for wetting and bubbles: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
